storage: Keep in the fridge at all times; stir before use. Freezing is possible but changes texture. Cooked idli or dosa: fridge, 1–2 days.
looksLike: Thick, pale cream, slightly sour-smelling batter with tiny bubbles, sold chilled in 500 g and 1 kg pouches or tubs.
shelfLife: Typically a few days chilled to about a week; follow the date on the pack. Once opened, use within 2–3 days.

iD Fresh idli and dosa batter

usedIn.raw: 180 g fermented batter per serving (2 uttapams, 90 g each). The dish file's base recipe makes this batter at home from idli rice (55 g), split urad dal (18 g), fenugreek seeds (0.4 g) and salt (1 g) per serving's share of a 650 g batch, priced through those ingredients' own entries; ready-made packaged batter, priced here, is the shop-bought alternative for the same 180 g. Use one costing or the other, not both.
